scenarios.title: Cáceres public-parcel demo: a staged claim and missing exclusions
scenarios.summary: Five complete public SIGPAC examples are shown for learning, not as one real holding. D04's published Polygon has three inner rings; the private demo intentionally fills those holes as an original-claim mistake. Published area 63.0449 ha and CSP 90 produce the calculated indicative figure 56.74041 ha, not an official supplied maximum, eligibility or payment decision.
scenarios.farmer_goal: Compare the staged D04 private outline with the exact public reference, restore only the boundary actually checked, and separately review the proposed claim number.
scenarios.adviser_goal: Check public source provenance, all four proposed facts and the staged boundary error without treating neighboring public parcels as one client holding or a private correction as an official update.
expected_actions: Open the five public-reference examples. D01–D05 are selected neighboring public recintos, not evidence that one farmer owns, leases or claims all of them.

Inspect D04: the private original intentionally uses only the published outer ring, filling three actual inner exclusions. Compare it with the unchanged public reference, preserve all three holes in any proposal, save the proposal and apply it only after a separate human review.

Keep the published source unchanged. The staged private outline's geometry-derived area is larger than the reference because the holes were filled; published superficie 63.0449 ha is a different retained source attribute, not a measurement of that staged drawing.

Check the original demo claim of 63.0449 ha and the published admisibilidad/CSP 90. The product 63.0449 × 0.90 = 56.74041 ha is an app/example calculation, not a supplied official maximum, final eligible area, rounding rule, payment or penalty.
Review the proposed future claim of 56.74041 ha separately. All four facts start proposed; no real original filing, amendment, receipt or acceptance is seeded.
Retain raw incidence code 140 as uninterpreted source text. Do not invent its meaning or treat it as a verified protected-area designation or automatic disqualification.

If disputing the public source, check actual evidence and the current official route. No lease, dated geotagged photo, right to clear scrub or authority decision is supplied by this demo. National amendment deadlines, source campaign and imagery capture date remain unknown.
